summary: Reliability batch (email queue+log, campaign status lifecycle, admin email-log page) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest: 12/12 pass. PATCH /api/campaigns/{cid}/status cycle live→paused→live→closed→live works (notified:true), same-status is idempotent (notified:false, 'Already X'), invalid=400, employee=403, unauth=401. For each change the background task inserts: one notifications doc per active verified customer (title contains LIVE/PAUSED/CLOSED), one broadcasts doc of kind campaign_live/paused/closed with recipients=active_customer_count, and email_log rows (preview @example.com failed with 'HTTP 422 Undeliverable', attempts=1, no 429 on preview recipients). activity_logs gets campaign_status_changed + email_failed (actor_name 'System') entries. GET /api/admin/email-log works (shape {items, sent_24h, failed_24h}), ?status=sent/failed filters, ?q=example.com filters, employee=403. Employee check-in/out endpoints respond (200/400 'Already'). Frontend Admin: /rt-control-hb27 → admin login + PIN 2580 → /admin/campaigns, cycled Axis Mutual Fund SIP paused→live→closed→live via status-* data-testids, each produced correct success toast ('… paused — customers notified', 'LIVE — customers notified by email', '… closed — customers notified'). Sidebar group Communication contains Email Log link; /admin/email-log renders email-log-stats (last24h attempted 43 / delivered 5 / failed 38), filter buttons All/Sent/Failed, search box filters rows (28 for 'example.com'), each row has Sent/Failed status pill and HTTP 422 error text for failed rows. Customer /app/login + PIN 2468 → bell shows new Campaign LIVE/PAUSED/CLOSED: Axis Mutual Fund SIP notifications, click targets /app/my-campaigns.

critical_code_review_comments: email_service.send_email has an unreachable `logger.error ... return None` block after the final `await _log(...); return None` (lines 155-156). Dead code — safe to remove.

announce_campaign_status serialises email sends via the throttle lock inside the loop; with multiple rapid status changes to the same campaign, consecutive background tasks can overlap and share the global _send_lock. During testing we observed provider HTTP 429 for real recipient (harishbhati4581@gmail.com) when 4 cycles were fired <2min apart. The 5-step exponential backoff recovers but the whole broadcast can take ~60-90s per cycle. Consider per-campaign serialisation (asyncio.Lock keyed by campaign_id) so overlapping admin actions queue cleanly.

broadcasts doc is inserted ONLY after the full email loop finishes. If the loop is slow or process restarts mid-way, the broadcast record is lost even though some emails/notifications were sent. Consider writing the broadcast row first (sent=0,failed=0) and incrementing counters as sends complete.

live-again branch sets link = /campaign/{slug} but campaign_status_email always links to /app/dashboard for non-live states — status 'live' re-run still uses /campaign/{slug} in email which is correct, consistent.
GET /api/campaigns param to include non-live is `admin_view=true` (not `all=true` as the task spec suggested). Minor doc discrepancy but code is fine.
